links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of zero-shot MLLMs for apical periodontitis detection, relevant to standalone diagnostic use
links.effect: Accuracy up to 71.67% (Gemini). Claude sensitivity 95.00%, specificity 13.33%; GPT-5.2 sensitivity 20.00%, specificity 98.33%. None reliable enough for independent clinical use.
links.quote: Although diagnostic performance varied among models, none achieved a level of diagnostic performance sufficient for independent clinical use.

links.outcome: Comparison of three candidate MLLMs against each other and a clinician reference standard on same images
links.effect: Gemini 3.0 Pro accuracy 71.67%, significantly superior to Claude 4.5 Sonnet (Bonferroni-adjusted p = 0.0015); models differed in sensitivity and specificity trade-offs.
links.quote: This performance was significantly superior to that of Claude 4.5 Sonnet (Bonferroni-adjusted p = 0.0015).

screen.reason: Evaluates zero-shot diagnostic accuracy of several general-purpose MLLMs on dental radiographs against a clinician-labeled dataset without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
